scripts.speaker: Freidrich
scripts.text: ^3355FFJuno^000000 is kept aloft in the air by an ancient and mysterious force.

scripts.speaker: Freidrich
scripts.text: This power is said to come from a relic from an ancient civilization called ^3355FFJuperos^000000 which existed here long before Juno.

scripts.speaker: Freidrich
scripts.text: Research revealed that Juno's power source based on ^3355FFPieces of Ymir's Heart^000000. I hear that this power source is found where Juperos used to exist.

scripts.speaker: Freidrich
scripts.text: Since many scholars have been coming to Juno to study and research this power source, our city is basically a well known mecca for scholars.

scripts.speaker: Freidrich
scripts.text:
The city of Sages,
^3355FFJuno,^000000 is made of
three islands.

scripts.speaker: Freidrich
scripts.text: These are Solomon, the island of honor, Mineta, the island of prosperity, and Snotora, the island of knowledge.

scripts.speaker: Freidrich
scripts.text:
The location of each island is
North-west : Solomon
North-east : Snotora
South : Mineta.

scripts.speaker: Granny
scripts.text: So, do you enjoy candy?

scripts.speaker: Granny
scripts.text:
*Giggle giggle*
The time has come.
Well then...

scripts.speaker: Granny
scripts.text: I am an old Sage granny who foresees everything...
^3355FFGranny hands you some candy^000000.

scripts.speaker: Granny
scripts.text: You've already chosen. It doesn't matter whether or not you get this candy. That doesn't matter at all. You have to understand why it's happened.

scripts.speaker: Granny
scripts.text:
Here's ^3355FF1,000 zeny^000000.
Do you accept this?
Accept
Do not accept

scripts.speaker: Granny
scripts.text:
*Giggle*
There you go~

scripts.speaker: Granny
scripts.text:
*Giggle*
Well then...
See you ~

scripts.speaker: Granny
scripts.text: Yes, that's right. Now you must ask yourself why you didn't accept the candy I offered.

scripts.speaker: Granny
scripts.text: Have you heard of a boss monster that has been around Juno for a long time? It's known only as the ^FF3355Lord of the Dead^000000.

scripts.speaker: Granny
scripts.text: It is rumored to be from the realm of the dead. It brings many undead monsters with it, intending to lead living creatures to its cold and icy realm.

scripts.speaker: Granny
scripts.text: You have already chosen whether or not you will challenge the Lord of the Dead. All you need to do right now is understand why you made the decision.

scripts.speaker: Sergiof
scripts.text:
My name is Sergiof,
the fighter who
serves Granny.

scripts.speaker: Sergiof
scripts.text: I will tell you about ^3355FFGrand Peco^000000 which is a high level Peco Peco. Grand Peco is faster than Peco Peco and is quite aggressive.

scripts.speaker: Sergiof
scripts.text: It attacks using its strong bill and many Peco Pecos follow it. There's quite a difference in power between Peco Peco and the Grand Peco.

scripts.speaker: Ninno
scripts.text: You are very lucky to have me tell you this story. This only happens by ^FF33551 out of a 1,000 chance^000000.

scripts.speaker: Ninno
scripts.text: Have you ever heard of an Egyptian king who was once believed to be a son of a god? His name is ^3355FFPharoah^000000.

scripts.speaker: Ninno
scripts.text: This world you are experiencing is actually fabricated! It's time for you to see reality for what it is!

scripts.speaker: Ninno
scripts.text: Open your eyes! Stop being manipulated by virtual reality!

scripts.speaker: Ninno
scripts.text: He was rumored to be a high sorcerer that used his power to curse innocents. It is said that he is still around, placing his curses on people.

scripts.speaker: Ninno
scripts.text: As an adventurer, it's possible that you may see him in your travels. Be careful...

scripts.speaker: Le Morpheus
scripts.text: Look in my hand. I am holding two different kinds of herbs.

scripts.speaker: Le Morpheus
scripts.text: Hmm. I'm sorry to say you just missed a fortunate chance. However, I can tell you don't have enough wealth to bring this fortune to fruition.

scripts.speaker: Le Morpheus
scripts.text:
^3355FFApocalypse^000000...
It is the name of an android that used to guard Juno long ago.

scripts.speaker: Le Morpheus
scripts.text: One is a ^3355FFBlue Herb^000000 which will make you forget about reality and keep you in this virtual reality^000000.

scripts.speaker: Le Morpheus
scripts.text: The other is a ^FF3355Red Herb^000000 which will reveal to you what is true and real.

scripts.speaker: Le Morpheus
scripts.text: Whichever one you choose, you must spend ^3355FF5,000 zeny^000000. Now, please select one.
Choose ^FF3355Red Herb^000000
Choose ^3355FFBlue Herb^000000.

scripts.speaker: Le Morpheus
scripts.text: As you have chosen, you will forget everything, and remain in this virtual reality.

scripts.speaker: Le Morpheus
scripts.text: You will see the truth.

scripts.speaker: Le Morpheus
scripts.text: Because its artificial intelligence has corrupted over the years, it can no longer distinguish comrades from enemies. Sadly, that android is nothing but a mindless monster now.

scripts.speaker: Artisan
scripts.text: *Mumble mumble...*

scripts.speaker: Artisan
scripts.text: Oh, hello there. Let me introduce myself. I am an artisan who tries to succeed the rights and duties of item makers in Juno.
About Powerful Equipment
About Unique Items
About Authentic Food
End Conversation

scripts.speaker: Artisan
scripts.text: Let me suggest the ^3355FFHoly Guard^000000 and ^3355FFHoly Avenger^000000 which are special items for Crusaders.

scripts.speaker: Artisan
scripts.text: These pieces of equipment are very light and have sufficient abilities. They also happen to possess holy power.

scripts.speaker: Artisan
scripts.text: Therefore, this equipment is more powerful over some kinds of monsters such as Ghosts or the Undead.

scripts.speaker: Artisan
scripts.text: However it is rumored that only a few chosen Crusaders are able to obtain those items due of their rarity.

scripts.speaker: Artisan
scripts.text: It looks like a simple scroll marked with concentric circles and a star. Although the ^FF3355Worn-Out Magic Scroll^000000 is very old, it's wanted by many Sages for research purposes.

scripts.speaker: Artisan
scripts.text: It seems you can use that item when you chant a high-level magic spell.

scripts.speaker: Artisan
scripts.text: ^3355FFRice Cake^000000! Yes, it's a traditional food that's favored by a lot of people. There's a lot of nostalgic memories of old fashioned markets that are connected to the Rice Cake.

scripts.speaker: Artisan
scripts.text:
Ahhh~
I wish I could eat a bit of Rice Cake right now.

scripts.speaker: Artisan
scripts.text: Although Juno is known as a city of Sages, I hope you understand that ordinary people live and prosper here as well. Please enjoy the unique atmosphere that Juno has to offer.

scripts.speaker: Juno Soldier
scripts.text: Welcome to Juno, the city of noble-mindedness.

scripts.speaker: Juno Soldier
scripts.text: There is a monster near here known as Lava Golem. This golem is made from a stone heart whose power happened to be amplified with magic power when it was swept away by molten rock.

scripts.speaker: Juno Soldier
scripts.text: The lava dripping from its body is so hot that it can melt down armor and weapons made out of high quality steel.

scripts.speaker: Juno Soldier
scripts.text: You'd better be careful when you encounter this monster. It will damage armor and weapons in the twinkling of an eye.

scripts.speaker: Juno Soldier
scripts.text: Welcome to Juno, the city of noble-mindedness.

scripts.speaker: Juno Soldier
scripts.text:
Geographer...
That monster looks like a flower blooming from the ground.

scripts.speaker: Juno Soldier
scripts.text: Strangely, it can extend its body a long distance. Even if you're far away from it, it can still pose a threat.

scripts.speaker: Juno Soldier
scripts.text: The name of this monster originated from a story about a poor geographer who, unfortunately, was eaten by this monster while he was immersed in his studies.

scripts.speaker: Juno Soldier
scripts.text: Welcome to Juno, the city of noble-mindedness.

scripts.speaker: Juno Soldier
scripts.text: Near Juno, there exists a fallen angel named 'False Angel.' It feigns innocence, pretending to bless adventurers and then stabbing them in the back without any warning.

scripts.speaker: Juno Soldier
scripts.text: Don't be fooled by its appearance, or you'll find yourself in trouble.

scripts.speaker: Juno Soldier
scripts.text: Welcome to Juno, the city of noble-mindedness.

scripts.speaker: Juno Soldier
scripts.text: 'Goat' is a monster that was an antelope living in the high mountains that was somehow turned into a monster.

scripts.speaker: Juno Soldier
scripts.text: Even if you manage to dodge to its horns, you still need to be wary of its powerful legs.

scripts.speaker: Juno Soldier
scripts.text: Goat's legs are so strong because it's always climbing cliffs when it's not busy slaughtering the innocent.

scripts.speaker: Juno Soldier
scripts.text: Welcome to Juno, the city of noble-mindedness.

scripts.speaker: Juno Soldier
scripts.text:
Have you ever
seen a Large Jellopy?
Those things are huuuge!

scripts.speaker: Juno Soldier
scripts.text:
It's hard to believe
that such a large and
shining jellopy even exists!

scripts.speaker: Juno Soldier
scripts.text: Welcome to Juno, the city of noble-mindedness.

scripts.speaker: Juno Soldier
scripts.text: Among the Sage's weapons, there is a 'Dagger of Counter.'

scripts.speaker: Juno Soldier
scripts.text: Its use is limited to the Sage class, and it increases the chance of inflicting critical attacks. So, for Sages, that dagger can be very useful, as well as make them look stylish in battle.

scripts.speaker: Juno Soldier
scripts.text: Welcome to Juno, the city of noble-mindedness.

scripts.speaker: Juno Soldier
scripts.text: There is a holy shield named 'Sacred Mission' which can only be used by Crusaders.

scripts.speaker: Juno Soldier
scripts.text: It's a long and narrow shield with an angel wing engraved in the center of the front side. Against Devil and Undead monsters, it is especially powerful.

scripts.speaker: Airship Representative
scripts.text:
Good day, I am here to inform you
about the Juno Airship which
we plan to operate in the near future.

scripts.speaker: Air ship Representative
scripts.text:
Unfortunately, it is still in
development, and we've yet
to complete testing. However,
we feel the need to let our
eager customers know of our
progress.

scripts.speaker: Airship Representative
scripts.text: The Airship we're developing will provide you with convenient travel to any town. You can also enjoy the sights while aloft in the sky. Unique products from various areas will also be provided.

scripts.speaker: Airship Representative
scripts.text:
We promise our customers an
amazing travel experience
once the Airship is in
operation. In the meantime,
we are providing a special
teleport service.

scripts.speaker: Airship Representative
scripts.text: The teleport fee is 1,800 zeny, regardless of where you want to go. Please let me know your desired destination.
Prontera
Izlude
Geffen
Morocc
Payon
Alberta
Comodo
Cancel

scripts.text:
